title: Periods under a winding map
promptMarkdown: For the angular form $\omega$ in the lesson, compute its pullback by $\gamma_k(t)=(\cos kt,\sin kt)$, $0\le t\le2\pi$, for every integer $k$. Prove $\omega$ is not exact, and determine the induced map on $H^1_{\mathrm{dR}}(S^1)$ of the map $e^{it}\mapsto e^{ikt}$ once the circle period class is used as a basis. Include $k=0$ and negative $k$.
hintLadder: Differentiate both components of the winding curve.
Integrate an exact form using the fundamental theorem on the parameter interval.
A periodic one-form with zero mean has a periodic primitive.
